$comment: Machine-readable definition of done. Only flip passes to true with evidence (a command that ran, an artifact that exists). Workers never edit verify commands or acceptance criteria — that's a spec change, report it.

features.title: Visual damage and guard resolve at contact
features.acceptance: Displayed health, wounds and guard retain pre-contact values during windup/travel, then update at impact, without delaying or changing simulation. Cover enemy hits, player hits, counter/riposte, terminal flow, queue, reduced motion and fast-forward.
features.evidence: Iteration 1: 12 contact regressions fail on unchanged #104 and pass after production fix; analyzer clean; full suite 1399/1399 including existing queue and terminal coverage. See progress.md; logs retained for final evidence package.

features.title: Articulated Kindler/Warden action with attached weapon
features.acceptance: Kindler and Warden show distinct upper/lower-body and arm action, readable low/high die commitment and planted recovery. Body and weapon share a moving grip through idle, attack, guard and fatigue; recognizable roster identity and other roster fallback preserved. Owner requested improved character designs on September 18; matching new art is allowed.

features.title: More suitable Kindler and Warden character designs
features.acceptance: Integrate redesigned Kindler and Warden in portraits and combat: distinct silhouettes, forge/ash role-appropriate costume, weapons coherent with gameplay, readable at native mobile sizes. Preserve all 22 IDs, abilities, unlocks, binary alpha, frame margins and memory budgets. Record source provenance and reproducible production build; show actual renders, not just concepts. Other 20 sheets unchanged.
